study_identification_part.si_4_title: Brain-Charting Autism and Attention-Deficit/Hyperactivity Disorder Reveals Distinct and Overlapping Neurobiology

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: ABIDE (I+II); ADHD-200; HBN; femaleASD; POND, UCSD, and UK MRC-AIMS (mapped to MULTI-DATASET); BrainChart (None (Pre-Trained NM))
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: "T1-weighted scans were combined from 49 sites across 7 datasets, including the ABIDE (Autism Brain Imaging Data Exchange) (102,103), the POND (Province of Ontario Neurodevelopmental) Network, the HBN (Healthy Brain Network) at the Child Mind Institute (104), the ADHD200 Consortium, the Multimodal Developmental Neurogenetics of Females with ASD dataset from the National Institute of Mental Health Data Archive, the UK MRC-AIMS (Medical Research Council Autism Imaging Multi-centre Study), and the University of California San Diego Biomarkers of Autism study."
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.location: Bedford2025.pdf.md: METHODS AND MATERIALS / Sample and Datasets

dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: The 7 datasets (ABIDE, POND, etc.) were used as the study sample to characterize alterations. The BrainChart model (Pre-Trained NM) was used as the reference.
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.supporting_text: "Here, we leveraged models of average brain development previously characterized by our group (98) to quantify alterations related to autism and ADHD... The final dataset ... included 4255 individuals ..."
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.location: Bedford2025.pdf.md: METHODS AND MATERIALS / Sample and Datasets

dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.detail: The normative model was pre-trained on 75,241 individuals.
dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.supporting_text: "benchmarked against models of average brain development based on a sample of more than 75,000 individuals."

dc_4_age_info_of_each_normative_nodel.detail: The paper states the model covers the 'life span' but does not provide specific age statistics for the 75,241 reference individuals, only for the study sample.
dc_4_age_info_of_each_normative_nodel.supporting_text: "to map neuroanatomical developmental trajectories across the life span, using a sample of 75,241 TD individuals"
dc_4_age_info_of_each_normative_nodel.location: Bedford2025.pdf.md: METHODS AND MATERIALS / Generation of Centile Scores...

dc_5_sex_info_of_each_normative_nodel.detail: Sex distribution for the BrainChart reference sample is not reported in this paper.
dc_5_sex_info_of_each_normative_nodel.supporting_text: "using a sample of 75,241 TD individuals... accounting for effects of age, sex, and site/scanner."
